# Generated by tools/cm_generate_town_rights_allow.py - do not edit by hand.

# Country trigger. Mirrors each vanilla town_rights_type `allow` block so auto-grant
# only grants a right on a location the engine would allow it on.
# Expects scope:cm_town_right (the right) and scope:target (the candidate location).
# Rights with no `allow` restriction fall through to the trailing trigger_else.
cm_can_grant_specific_town_right_at_location = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { scope:cm_town_right = town_rights_type:staple_port }
		scope:target = {
			is_port = yes
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cm_town_right = town_rights_type:granary_town }
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:imperial_breadbasket_rights }

	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:cm_town_right = town_rights_type:market_charter }

				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:staple_port
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:free_town_charter
			}

		limit = { scope:cm_town_right = town_rights_type:free_town_charter }
